transcript:
Received and recorded, City Clerk's Office: 2026 NOV 12 P 12:07

# MEETING MINUTES

- Board: Golf and Tennis Commission
- Date: October 13, 2026
- Location: Beverly Golf & Tennis
- Members Present: Chair William Lowd, Vice-Chair Martin Lawler, Kevin Ascolillo, Chad Crandall, Paul Sciamanna
- Members Absent: Arthur Athanas
- Guests: Chris Carter, Steve Murphy, Dave Gellineau, Sean Ciancarelli
- Recorder: Donna Musumeci

## Minutes

Chad Crandall: Motion to approve the minutes September 15, 2026. Kevin Ascolillo seconded. The motion carries (5-0).

## Financial Update

Martin advised the 2027 Enterprise Fund Accounts for maintenance, course improvements, clubhouse improvements and other, are being set up. Bills paid included Impact Fire, American Refrigerator, FW Webb, Bass River Tennis and BSC, bills pending are Dino Paving, Green Jackets, the 10 Trees for Hole 16, Buckley Elevator inspection, and Dura Built fence for the slats. Steve Murphy advised the 10 trees were planted; and has also spoken with the neighbors and had a white "aiming rock" identified to help avoid balls into the neighbor's yards.

Chris advised a neighbor called, happy with the new fencing, but now kids and grown ups are using their driveway to cut through the course thru a hole in the connecting area to the new fence. Jim T will follow up with the neighbor for a solution. Still pending is the Hole 8 to 9 bridge. Sean C. to get an update.

## Site Projects / Status/ Discussions & Updates

Bill L. reviewed the priority list in process and plan for fall/winter. Jim T. is out straight working the list. Plastic strips were installed in the refrigerator downstairs.

## BG&T Capital Projects

Clubhouse windows – Catherine from the city Grant office, went to the CPC meeting and advised them BG&T is interested in renovating the windows at the clubhouse. Catherine submitted a pre-application with details of the project and advised we would add funding to the CPC money if awarded. Bill advised Catherine wrote it up with what we had talked about and to do it in two phases.

## GFMI Update

Chris advised the rounds for the month, was a little shy of last year's numbers. We got wiped out for 3-4 days due to the nor'easter. Reviewed the revenue report. Chris is currently contacting the next ten on the waitlist; they can pay now or can make a deposit. Come next month, we will see how many are not coming back and adjust again. Right now, there are ninety on the waitlist, so we can take ten more next May (2027) to add to the waitlist.

Chris advised on rates for next year. May want to consider raising the rates so we can be closing in on revenue and to have revenue shareing; also, to help with future projects.. Chris will propose a few rates at the next meeting. All feel we are the lowest in the area for the cost of playing.

Course Irrigation – we agreed to do a design plan so we can get costs on a new system. The plan will be valid for a couple of years. Once we do it, we can still operate around the install of the system.

Hole 18 - BSC is meeting with ConCom on 11/17/2026 to talk about how we approach the Conservation Commission next spring.

Kevin Ascolillo: Motion to adjourn the meeting, all in favor. The motion passes (5-0).
